prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Impeccable design-direction image for a shippable expert desktop web application
Primary request: Create a high-fidelity, implementation-realistic 1440px desktop web UI mockup for a page-by-page PowerPoint curation workstation. The visual direction is “透明活页手册”: a complete system inspired by boxed-software reference manuals and perforated transparent keyboard overlays, expressed as a web interface—not as a physical book photo.
Scene/backdrop: Straight-on full browser/app viewport, landscape 3:2. Dense professional workspace on a warm off-white canvas. A slim utility header at top with document name, page progress “12 / 48”, inherited-review indicator, and compact status controls. No browser chrome, no surrounding room.
Subject and layout: Left approximately 60% is a sanitized Chinese business presentation page preview with a bold title “区域经营概览”, abstract bar and line charts, a compact data table, and three clearly numbered visual-object crop boxes labeled “01”, “02”, “03”. The standard page render and numbered crop layers appear as stacked translucent acetate sheets with slight misregistration and crisp hard-edge shadows. Right approximately 36% is a dense editor drawn as one perforated loose-leaf acetate page, with visible binder holes along its left edge, ruled alignment cues, and stacked practical form sections.
Right editor content: clearly readable section headings “页面总述”, “视觉对象处置”, and “SUMMARY”; show object rows “01 图表  纳入”, “02 表格  纳入”, “03 装饰图形  排除”; include a textarea-like summary field; a prominent caution module labeled “未确认草稿”; and an explicit “PENDING 待审核” status with both icon and text. Include compact buttons or segmented controls for “批准”, “排除”, “重新打开”, while making pending the active state.
Navigation system: On the exposed front edge of the right editor, show five slim colored index tabs with the exact Chinese labels “来源”, “视觉对象”, “标注”, “审核”, “历史”, evoking full-color manual dividers under milky acetate.
Bottom command strip: full-width keyboard command bar with crisp keycaps and exact readable commands: “J 下一页”, “K 上一页”, “A 批准”, “X 排除”, “E 编辑”, “⌘S 保存”.
Style/medium: premium high-fidelity desktop UI design mockup, flat orthographic screen capture, practical React/HTML/CSS-feasible controls, highly legible modern Chinese sans-serif typography, compact spacing, strong information hierarchy, restrained editorial-industrial styling. Subtle manual-reference metaphor through layers, tabs, holes, crop marks, rules, and small technical annotations.
Color palette: warm ivory #F7F2E8, near-black #232629, mustard yellow #E4B624, teal #23867F, burnt orange #D85A32. Milky translucent acetate overlays full-color divider sheets. Use white/ivory fields and near-black text for contrast.
Materials/textures: restrained semi-opaque acetate, very subtle paper grain, sparse hard-edged 2–4px shadows, precise perforations, squared corners or tiny radii only.
Composition/framing: straight-on app screenshot filling the frame; top header about 7%, main split workspace about 84%, keyboard strip about 9%. Preview is dominant but editor remains fully visible. Preserve generous alignment despite high density.
Text (verbatim where visible): “区域经营概览”, “12 / 48”, “页面总述”, “视觉对象处置”, “SUMMARY”, “未确认草稿”, “PENDING 待审核”, “来源”, “视觉对象”, “标注”, “审核”, “历史”, “01 图表  纳入”, “02 表格  纳入”, “03 装饰图形  排除”, “批准”, “排除”, “重新打开”, “J 下一页”, “K 上一页”, “A 批准”, “X 排除”, “E 编辑”, “⌘S 保存”.
Constraints: clearly a realizable desktop web application; sanitized fictional business data only; three numbered visual object boxes; include keyboard commands; accessibility cues pair color with text/icons; no real brands or confidential content.
Avoid: marketing landing page or hero composition, real book or photographed desk, photoreal physical objects, people, background photography, gradients, glassmorphism, glossy 3D, excessive rounded cards, pill overload, huge empty space, mobile UI, illegible decorative microtext, warped perspective, neon, fantasy concept art, logos, watermarks.
